 candle   SETUP   nothing trades until your agent and its limits exist                                                  
                                                                                                                        
 ╭─ Setup ──────────────────╮ ╭───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── step 1 of 5 ─╮ 
 │                          │ │                                                                                       │ 
 │ ✓ Welcome                │ │  Sign in to Candle                                                                    │ 
 │                          │ │                                                                                       │ 
 │ ▸ Sign in to Candle      │ │  This machine has no keychain, so the Candle CLI locks its sign-in file with a        │ 
 │                          │ │  passphrase you choose. Add this line to ~/.bashrc in an editor, with a passphrase    │ 
 │ · Connect your agent     │ │  of your own, kept from then on:                                                      │ 
 │                          │ │                                                                                       │ 
 │ · Wallet and limits      │ │    export CANDLE_KEYRING_PASSPHRASE="<a passphrase of your own>"                      │ 
 │                          │ │  ▸ ⧉ Copy the line            paste it into ~/.bashrc in an editor, not at a prompt   │ 
 │ · The tour               │ │    ⧉ chmod 600 ~/.bashrc                run it after, so only you can read the file   │ 
 │                          │ │                                                                                       │ 
 │ · Where to start         │ │  Then quit (ctrl-c twice) and run candle-harness in a new terminal.                   │ 
 │                          │ │                                                                                       │ 
 │                          │ │  Or keep the owner sign-in off this machine: make an agent's key where you're signed  │ 
 │                          │ │  in, quit, and add it here:                                                           │ 
 │                          │ │    ⧉ candle-harness key add --agent agent-a                     it asks for the key   │ 
 │                          │ │                                                                                       │ 
 │                          │ │  This isn't a vault's passphrase. It only locks the CLI's sign-in file.               │ 
 │                          │ │                                                                                       │ 
 │                          │ │                                                                                       │ 
 │                          │ │                                                                                       │ 
 │ about 5 minutes          │ │                                                                                       │ 
 │ quit any time: it picks  │ │                                                                                       │ 
 │ up where you stopped     │ │                                                                                       │ 
 ╰──────────────────────────╯ ╰───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
